name: Lands and landfall
description: Extra land drops, cards that reward you whenever a land enters, useful lands and ways to find more of them, in green, red and white.

cards.name: Hedgerow Wanderer
cards.rule_text:
You may play an additional land on each of your turns.
Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, you gain 1 life.
cards.flavor_text: She has never slept in the same field twice.

cards.name: Trailmarker Scout
cards.rule_text: When CARDNAME enters or dies, search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.

cards.name: Wake the Buried Hills
cards.rule_text: Search your library for up to two basic land cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle. You gain 2 life for each land put onto the battlefield this way.

cards.name: Ridgeback Grazer
cards.rule_text:
Trample
Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.

cards.name: Ever-Spreading Shoots
cards.rule_text:
Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, create a 0/1 green Plant creature token.
{2}{G}, Sacrifice four Plants: Draw two cards.

cards.name: Loamseer of the Low Fields
cards.rule_text:
{T}: Add {G}.
Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, you may pay {1}. If you do, draw a card. This ability triggers only once each turn.

cards.name: Gather the Fallen Stones
cards.rule_text: Return up to two target land cards from your graveyard to your hand. You gain 2 life.

cards.name: Rumblestep Elemental
cards.rule_text: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent.
cards.flavor_text: Every step it takes, the ground answers.

cards.name: Split-Earth Blast
cards.rule_text: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to any target. If a land you control entered this turn, it deals 4 damage instead.

cards.name: Scree Runner
cards.rule_text:
Haste
Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, CARDNAME gets +2/+0 until end of turn.

cards.name: Seam-Cutter Prospector
cards.rule_text: When CARDNAME enters, you may sacrifice a land. If you do, search your library for up to two basic land cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.

cards.name: Wayside Pilgrim
cards.rule_text: When CARDNAME enters, if an opponent controls more lands than you, search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
cards.flavor_text: The road is long, but it is never empty.

cards.name: Border Keep Captain
cards.rule_text:
Soldiers you control have vigilance.
Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, create a 1/1 white Soldier creature token.

cards.name: Banner of Claimed Ground
cards.rule_text: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, creatures you control get +1/+0 and gain vigilance until end of turn.

cards.name: Gundrel, Shaker of Peaks
cards.rule_text:
You may play an additional land on each of your turns.
Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to any target.
cards.flavor_text: Where he walks, mountains learn to move.

cards.name: Orlaith, Warden of the Long Meadow
cards.rule_text:
Vigilance
Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.

cards.name: Shattered Rise
cards.rule_text:
CARDNAME enters tapped.
When CARDNAME enters, you may return target land card from your graveyard to your hand.
{T}: Add {R} or {G}.

cards.name: Broken Cairn Steppe
cards.rule_text:
{T}: Add {C}.
{1}, {T}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle. You gain 1 life.

cards.name: Beastcaller's Hollow
cards.rule_text:
{T}: Add {C}.
{4}{G}, {T}: Create a 3/3 green Beast creature token. Activate only as a sorcery.

cards.name: Sunward Fortress
cards.rule_text:
{T}: Add {C}.
{2}{W}, {T}: Target creature you control gains indestructible until end of turn.
